summary: RptDestProfileSummary is a user control within the HSPnet application, responsible for generating and managing report jobs for destination profiles.
purpose: This module facilitates the creation of reports related to destination profiles, ensuring that report generation adheres to specified conditions and limits.

workflows.name: Report Generation
steps: Check if user session allows report execution.
Handle errors if no destinations or if maximum limit exceeded.
Generate report job for the valid destination list.

business_rules: Maximum allowed destination items for report: PrintJobs.MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS.
validations: cmdRunReport visibility check based on UserSession.SwitchUserViewOnly.
system_behavior: Shows error messages when report conditions are not met.
exceptions: Report not created if destination count is zero or exceeds maximum allowed.
